about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a 2nd-year engineering student at ENSAM Casablanca, specializing in Cybersecurity & Cloud Computing. My focus sits at the intersection of defensive operations, offensive testing, and cloud infrastructure.

I've built full SOC environments, deployed deception architectures for industrial OT/SCADA systems, analyzed malware in isolated labs, and trained ML models for intrusion detection. I genuinely enjoy the whole loop — simulating the attack, catching it, and closing the gap.
Beyond the keyboard, I lead projects for The Purple HAT cybersecurity club and serve as Secretary General of the Sawaid Al Amal social club.

highlights: Deployed a multi-layer cyber-deception architecture (Purdue model) with 8 Docker honeypots simulating PLC/SCADA environments, capturing and analyzing dozens of simulated attacks.
Built centralized monitoring with Wazuh, Suricata and OpenCTI, improving threat detection and enrichment through event correlation.
Ran penetration tests in OT/SCADA environments and assessed vulnerabilities against NIST SP 800-82 and IEC 62443, strengthening the overall security posture.

items.title: Check Point Firewall Deployment
items.subtitle: ENSAM Datacenter · in progress
items.summary: High-availability Check Point R82 firewall deployment with a secure multi-zone architecture.
details: Deployed Check Point R82 in high availability (ClusterXL) on EVE-NG / Proxmox with a secure multi-zone design.
Configured Firewall, IPS, IPsec/SSL VPN and Active Directory integration, improving access control and network segmentation.

items.title: SOC Platform — Network Supervision & Attack Simulation
items.subtitle: Detection engineering lab
items.summary: Full SOC platform for centralized detection and Red/Blue team validation.
details: Built a SOC platform on VMware integrating pfSense, Active Directory, Suricata and Wazuh for centralized detection.
Simulated 15 Red/Blue team scenarios to validate detection rules and improve incident visibility.

items.title: Malware Analysis Lab — Static & Dynamic
items.subtitle: Isolated reverse-engineering environment
items.summary: Isolated lab for safely analyzing malware behavior and extracting IOCs.
details: Built a lab with FlareVM, REMnux and INetSim to analyze malware in an isolated environment.
Performed static and dynamic analysis, producing detailed reports on behavior and indicators of compromise (IOCs).

items.title: Machine Learning Intrusion Detection System
items.subtitle: ML-powered IDS · 98% accuracy
items.summary: An IDS driven by ML models reaching 98% accuracy with a live dashboard.
details: Developed an ML-based IDS (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost) achieving 98% accuracy.
Reduced false positives using PCA and built an interactive Streamlit dashboard for visualization.

items.title: SOC Anomaly Detection with Wazuh & ML
items.subtitle: Behavioral analytics pipeline
items.summary: Behavioral anomaly detection combining Wazuh telemetry with a custom risk-scoring model.
details: Simulated attacks with Atomic Red Team and collected logs via Wazuh for behavioral analysis.
Developed a Python model with risk scoring, improving anomaly detection through a Streamlit dashboard.
